result.narrow_conclusion_text_ACCEPTED_2026_09_: On a fixed pipeline, positive coordinate rescaling preserves the native sign representation exactly while raising retrieval score after full orthogonal mixing. The LoCoMo computation reproduced numerically from verified raw data across 92,100 question/seed/arm records. Denominator instability in the block-normalised comparisons, together with preregistration aggregation and interpretation inconsistencies, limits any comparative mechanism inference. Post-hoc sensitivity analyses do not repair that limit; they make it visible. Not a general mechanism result, not a production claim, and not a generalisation to other encoders or corpora. ACCEPTED 2026-09-07 with the limits recorded in head_researcher_acceptance_decision_2026_09_07 (L-059); the text itself is unchanged from the version that was proposed.
